title: Energy pull: how the particle count should scale with a thin draw
question: At this small a pull (2.25 energy per animal, well under the 40 cap), which flow reads as more honestly 'not much yet' — thin but still there, or thinner and closer to nothing?
context_md:
New (item 2 of your 2026-09-14 playtest): the mote count is now `floor + amount * slope` instead of a flat 26 regardless of how much you drew. Both arms here drew the same 18 energy from the same 8 animals (2.25 each, a pull taken early -- well under the 40 cap) on the same seed, so the only thing that differs is the formula. At a fuller pull (drew 120, 15/animal) the two arms give 15 and 17 motes -- close together -- so the floor is what this card is really asking about: how thin should the *thinnest real pull* look before it stops reading as "still charging" and starts reading as "basically nothing"?

- **A** floor 6, +0.6 per energy -- 7 motes at this pull, 30 at a full 40-energy one
- **B** floor 2, +1.0 per energy -- 4 motes at this pull, 42 at a full 40-energy one
